doc: The sources of the suggestion shell (panels/extra/suggestion_list.html?config=<id>; D-suggestions), in the order shown. letter picks one; label is its name on the dock; scripts are what it loads, its adapter last (lib/suggest/<id>.js, which registers Tezcatl.suggestSources[<id>] and turns the source into {columns, rows}); word and desc are the columns read; anywhere: its words may come at any place of the line (not only after the words before). One shell shows one source: they are never mixed. The launcher lists each as suggestion_list_<id> (list_kinds/panels_and_skins.json). test/suggestion.test.js checks this list against lib/suggest/ and the launcher.
